name: Canada
title: Holidays in Canada
intro: Mountains, lakes, whales and easy-going cities. Here's where to go on holiday in Canada, how long to stay and the best time to visit.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Canada?
faqs.answer: June to September suits most of Canada, from the Rockies to Quebec. Whistler is also a ski resort in winter.

faqs.question: Do UK visitors need a visa for Canada?
faqs.answer: Most British passport holders apply for an eTA online before they fly rather than a visa. Check GOV.UK for the current rules.

faqs.question: Where should we go in Canada?
faqs.answer: Banff and Whistler for mountains, Vancouver and Tofino for the west coast, and Montreal and Quebec City for French-speaking cities.
